title: RDPV Solutions, headless WordPress on Next.js
excerpt: Headless WordPress with a Next.js front end in Docker, behind Cloudflare DNS, for a technology, design and talent company.
content:
02 · Architect

Three divisions, one system

IT solutions, design and recruitment share one site and one design system, with WordPress as the editing tool and Next.js as the front end.

04 · Launch

Launch

RDPV Solutions went live as headless WordPress with a Next.js front end in Docker, DNS on Cloudflare and Google Analytics collecting only what is needed.
